summary.text: Ben Smaltz is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 52, assumed office on November 7, 2012, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Joseph Trost (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ben Smaltz graduated from Dekalb High School in 1988 and earned a B.S. in political science, history and marketing from Ball State University in 1993.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists Smaltz as chair of the Rules and Legislative Procedures Committee and a member of the House Joint Rules, Elections and Apportionment, and Ways and Means committees.
